Email Drafting: Writing or replying to an email in Outlook.
Email Summarising: Reading emails in Outlook to summarise or sort them.
Teams Messaging: Writing or posting a message in a Teams chat or channel.
Meeting Prep: Reading a meeting invite or calendar event to prepare or catch up.
Meeting Scheduling: Booking meetings, finding free time or managing a calendar.
Document Drafting: Writing or editing a document in Word.
Document Summarising: Reading a Word document to summarise it or answer questions about it.
Presentation Creation: Building or editing slides in PowerPoint.
Presentation Summarising: Reading a PowerPoint deck to summarise it or pull out key points.
Image Generation: Creating or editing an image, for example in Designer.
Image / Media Analysis: Looking at an image to describe or review it.
Video Summarising: Summarising or asking about a video or meeting recording.
Web Searching: Searching the public web to answer a question.
Enterprise Searching: Searching your organisation's own pages, lists and sites.
PDF Analysis: Reading a PDF to summarise it or answer questions about it.
SharePoint Access: Finding or browsing team content in SharePoint.
File Retrieval: Pulling a Word or PowerPoint file into a chat for context.
People Lookup: Finding colleagues, experts or who works with whom.
Data Querying: Querying a dataset, list or table to answer a data question.
Excel Assistance: Getting help with formulas, formatting or analysis in Excel.
Spreadsheet Review: Reading a spreadsheet or CSV file to check or explain the numbers.
Code Writing: Writing or changing code or scripts.
Code Analysis: Reading code or developer websites to explain, review or debug code.
Running a Workflow: Starting an automated flow or connector.
Specialist / Line-of-Business Workflow: Running an automated flow in a business system such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, Dynamics or Workday.
Email Workflow: Running an automated flow that sorts, routes or answers email.
Meeting Workflow: Running an automated flow that handles scheduling or meeting logistics.
Data & Reporting Workflow: Running an automated flow that refreshes data or produces a report.
Document Workflow: Running an automated flow that creates, files or shares documents.
Coordination Workflow: Running an automated flow that handles tasks, approvals or team notifications.
General Workflow: Running an automated multi-step flow that fits no narrower group.
Note Taking: Capturing or organising notes in OneNote.
Form / Survey Work: Building a form, quiz or survey in Forms, or reviewing its answers.
Task Management: Creating, tracking or updating tasks in Planner.
Real-time Collaboration: Working on something together in Loop, Whiteboard or Viva Engage.
Coaching: Using a coaching or learning agent to build skills or improve work.
Research & Analysis: Using a research or analyst agent to gather and make sense of information.
Sales & Customer: Using a sales or customer agent for accounts, deals or customer insight.
HR & People: Using an HR agent for hiring, onboarding or people questions.
Compliance & Policy: Using a policy, legal or risk agent to check rules and compliance.
IT & Service Desk: Using an IT or service desk agent to fix a problem or raise a ticket.
Content Generation: Using a writing agent to draft, summarise or translate content.
Data & Reporting: Using a data or reporting agent to query data or build a report.
Knowledge Base: Using a knowledge agent to answer questions from your organisation's guidance and documents.
Ideation & Creative: Using a creative agent to brainstorm ideas or design concepts.
General Assistance: Using an agent whose name and tools don't show what kind of work it did.
Domain-Specific Agent: Using a specialist agent built in Copilot Studio.
General Chat: Asking a question or chatting with AI, without a file, app or tool.
